SURFACE: dense fine parallel hatching everywhere (diagonal on the outer face, horizontal inside the passage) - reads as brick courses or rammed-earth layers. CONDITION: no cracks, breaches, missing patches or plants growing on the platform are drawn - it looks intact and maintained. TOP: no crenellated parapet (女墙/雉堞) or any defensive work; the top edge carries only the timber balustrades of the tower. X0204 构筑物/huanmen 471.1 cm street_north high
None · None
Tall multi-tier decorated gate (彩楼欢门) of bound timber poles built across the front of the wine house 孙羊正店, dressed with red flowers, scroll ornaments and hanging lanterns.
Tiers from the top: (1) CREST above the upper-floor railing, y150-425: six tall pointed spire frames bound with red ties and dressed with red flowers and leaves, some topped by a red bud-shaped finial, at x430-470 (left corner post, with a small lozenge ornament at y263-280), 615-672, 735-792, 860-918, 958-1005, 1045-1096; large curling scroll ornaments (cloud/ruyi-like) between them at x520-560 y290-385 and x940-1005 y360-415; the crest screens the upper-storey windows. (2) UPPER BAND y370-480: long horizontal entablature with two red-painted beams running from x225 to the right edge; its left end turns back diagonally (x225-320) like a hipped corner. (3) MIDDLE TIER y480-600: band of X-braced lattice frames with flower garlands and tassels; scroll ornaments at x395-453 y527-593, x620-660 y460-535, x798-865 y485-552, x1032-1090 y543-627; on the centre axis (x600-900, y380-640) a dense tower of red flowers rising through tiers 1-3. (4) LOWER PENT EAVE y590-720 with a red-striped beam; its centre part x490-1000 projects forward as a polygonal bay with angled ends (x490-560 and x900-1000), lined below with vertical slats.
